actions: Verified the current Mission View cold-bootstrap replay surface, 8 MiB tail boundary, event-log all-generation retention and rotation semantics, event-log writer lock scope, and Mission View projection lock directly against the pinned Argus public source.
Separated the currently executed under-replay gap from a distinct TOCTOU/deadlock risk that would arise in a naive all-generation remediation.

Persisted only a primary-verification audit and this immutable role-local receipt; no exploration worker state/feedback, control manifest, O state, downstream semantic output, or shared aggregate ledger was modified.
material_findings: Current Mission View cold bootstrap is source-level incomplete relative to the canonical retained event log because it reads only .1/live and at most the last 8 MiB of each.
A naive event_log_paths()-then-open-names repair is vulnerable to rollover path rebinding and can omit a retained generation despite durable history remaining present.
Acquiring events.lock inside the current Mission View critical section would invert the writer's events->mission lock order and creates a deadlock risk.
Pinned-descriptor/end-offset snapshotting is a plausible POSIX design direction but is not an implemented or validated Argus guarantee in the inspected commit.
exact_next_action: Rotate within sealed C24 to evaluation source blob 7bb6ffd55aba8007b6e12dbb71f3e4fe51c7546c. Verify the exact nine-split target-null minimax 5 delta/9 bound, the no-independence step, and the boundary between target-null decision safety and off-target numerical coverage from persisted theorem/validation artifacts before broader use.
